summary: Induction on j, commuting θ^F_j past the Heisenberg measures of the lower floors.

steps.lean:
j.rec (by simp! [descConv])
  (by grind [descConv_succ, ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_succ, _=_ mconv_assoc,
  mconv_comm_of_ae (F.ae_floorMeasure_mem.mono ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_dirac_comm)])

steps.claim: j + 1: 𝗆^F_{j+1} = (η_j ∗ θ^F_j) ∗ 𝗆^F_j = η_j ∗ θ^F_j ∗ ascConv(η, j) ∗ descConv(θ, 0, j) by the induction hypothesis; θ^F_j is carried by H_j and δ_s commutes with ascConv(η, j) for s ∈ H_j, so θ^F_j commutes with ascConv(η, j); regrouping gives (η_j ∗ ascConv(η, j)) ∗ (θ^F_j ∗ descConv(θ, 0, j)) = ascConv(η, j+1) ∗ descConv(θ, 0, j+1).
